muc.title: What if they ask something else?
muc.text: Tomorrow is your job interview in English. You memorized your answers, but what if they ask something different?

muc.title: AI plays a part
muc.text: That's when you use role-play. AI plays the interviewer, you're the candidate, and you talk like it's real.

muc.title: A 4-part prompt
muc.text: A good role-play prompt has four parts: AI's role, the setting, the difficulty, and a request for feedback after the practice.

muc.title: A sample prompt
muc.text: For example: play the HR manager of a travel company, interview me for a tour guide position, make it moderately hard, one question at a time, and at the end give me a score and three things to fix.

muc.title: Practice speaking for real
muc.text: To practice speaking, turn on voice mode. You talk, AI listens and answers right away, like a phone call.

muc.title: A new role is a new exercise
muc.text: Switch roles to switch exercises: a customer demanding a return, a partner pushing for a lower price, a parent with a complaint. Practice five times with AI, and the real thing is much less nerve-racking.

muc.title: 5 minutes of interview
muc.text: Turn on voice mode, paste the four-part prompt, and practice a five-minute interview. Afterwards, read the feedback carefully.

muc.title: Branching scenarios
muc.text: Role-play is one conversation. What if you want each choice to lead to a different ending? Part four: branching scenarios.
